SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_date <= required_delivery_date
                      THEN COALESCE(accepted_qty, 0) ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(SUM(ordered_qty), 0) AS value,
       COUNT(*) AS orders_in_window, SUM(ordered_qty) AS ordered_qty
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '200389' AND dc_id = 'DC2'
  AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 1)

SELECT 1.0 * (SUM(actual_demand_qty) - SUM(forecast_qty))
       / NULLIF(SUM(actual_demand_qty), 0) AS value,
       SUM(actual_demand_qty) AS actual_demand_qty, SUM(forecast_qty) AS forecast_qty
FROM scm_planning_01.demand_daily
WHERE sku_id = '200389' AND dc_id = 'DC2' AND demand_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 1)

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS breach_days,
       COUNT(*) AS days_observed, MAX(n.safety_stock_days) AS safety_stock_days
FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots s
JOIN scm_wms.inventory_norms n ON s.sku_id = n.sku_id AND s.dc_id = n.dc_id
WHERE s.sku_id = '200389' AND s.dc_id = 'DC2' AND s.snapshot_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 1)

       delivery_date, std_lead_time_days

WHERE sku_id = '200389' AND dc_id = 'DC2' AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 1)

SELECT AVG(1.0 * GREATEST(0, datediff(LEAST(COALESCE(delivery_date, DATE '2026-08-01'), DATE '2026-08-01'),
                                      dispatch_date) - std_lead_time_days)
           / std_lead_time_days) AS value,
       AVG(1.0 * datediff(LEAST(COALESCE(delivery_date, DATE '2026-08-01'), DATE '2026-08-01'),
                          dispatch_date)) AS avg_actual_lead_time_days,
       MAX(std_lead_time_days) AS std_lead_time_days,
       SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(delivery_date, DATE '2026-08-01') > required_delivery_date
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_or_overdue_orders
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '200389' AND dc_id = 'DC2'
  AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 1)

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.snapshot_date < date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 42)
                       AND s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.snapshot_date < date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 42) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS early_rate,
       1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.snapshot_date >= date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 42)
                       AND s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.snapshot_date >= date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 42) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS late_rate,
       COUNT(*) AS days_observed
FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots s
JOIN scm_wms.inventory_norms n ON s.sku_id = n.sku_id AND s.dc_id = n.dc_id
WHERE s.sku_id = '200389' AND s.dc_id = 'DC2' AND s.snapshot_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-01', 1)
